issues.legal_issue: An accused who acts in private defence but exceeds its limits may have a murder conviction reduced where the circumstances support the defence and the force used went beyond what it permitted.
material_facts: The accused and a co-accused were injured during the same occurrence, and the prosecution did not explain their injuries.
The occurrence arose suddenly; even the prosecution case was that the accused arrived unarmed and picked up objects at the scene.
The accused inflicted fatal injuries on two people and injured another person.
issues.conclusion: The accused had a right of private defence but exceeded it. His conviction for murder was set aside and replaced with a conviction for culpable homicide not amounting to murder; his convictions for attempted murder and house trespass were left undisturbed.
issues.legal_principle: The accused need not establish private defence beyond reasonable doubt; it is sufficient if the defence is supported on a preponderance of probabilities, and unexplained injuries sustained by the accused in the occurrence are relevant to that assessment. Where private defence is available but exceeded, Exception 2 to Section 300 of the Indian Penal Code applies, and the offence is punishable under Section 304 Part I. The Court referred generally to earlier decisions on the burden of proving private defence but did not identify any by name.

rule.if: appeal_from_murder_conviction and accused_injured_during_occurrence and prosecution_did_not_explain_accused_injuries and sudden_confrontation and accused_arrived_unarmed and accused_used_excessive_force

predicates.appeal_from_murder_conviction: The proceeding was an appeal challenging a murder conviction.
predicates.accused_injured_during_occurrence: The accused sustained injuries during the same occurrence in which the victims were injured.
predicates.prosecution_did_not_explain_accused_inju: The prosecution did not explain the injuries sustained by the accused.
predicates.accused_arrived_unarmed: The accused arrived without weapons and used objects found at the scene.
predicates.accused_used_excessive_force: The accused inflicted injuries that exceeded the force permitted in private defence.

issues.definition: When an appeal challenges a murder conviction and the accused was injured in an unexplained, sudden confrontation in which the accused arrived unarmed but used excessive force, the murder conviction is reduced to culpable homicide.

issues.legal_issue: A co-appellant's death during the pendency of an appeal results in the appeal abating as against that co-appellant.
material_facts: One of the two appellants died while the appeal was pending.
issues.conclusion: The appeal abated as against the deceased appellant.
issues.legal_principle: The Court treated the death of an appellant during the pending appeal as resulting in abatement of the appeal against that appellant; it cited no provision or earlier case for this disposition.

predicates.pending_appeal: A criminal appeal was pending before the Court.
predicates.appellant_died_during_appeal: An appellant died while the appeal was pending.

issues.definition: If an appellant dies while a criminal appeal is pending, the appeal abates as to that appellant.
